# Event → dashboard latency (generated by scripts/benchmark/ui_latency.py)

Boundary: event row committed in PostgreSQL (`persisted_at`) → new event painted in the browser (client ack after requestAnimationFrame, `dashboard_rendered_at`). Path: outbox claim → WebSocket `event_created` → React render. Same host clock for browser and server.

```json
{
 "session_minutes": 10.0,
 "events_persisted_during_session": 195,
 "events_with_render_ack": 195,
 "persist_to_dashboard_s": {
  "p50": 0.024,
  "p95": 0.052,
  "max": 0.24,
  "mean": 0.028
 },
 "target": "< 1 s (NFR-PERF-005)",
 "client": "headless msedge on the camera wall (10 live previews)"
}
```
